# Feature request

<!--
ferry is a focused post-production tool, and the maintainer makes scope calls.
Two decisions are settled and are not open for discussion here:

- Screen-reader support is declined. Please do not file a request for a
  VoiceOver or NVDA pass.
- The packaged app targets Apple Silicon macOS only. Windows and Linux were
  removed as desktop targets.

If your request touches either, say why you think the decision is wrong — a
well-argued case is welcome and will be read. Re-raising a settled decision
without a new argument is not.

Accessibility work that is not about speech output — focus order, labelling,
contrast, keyboard traps — is genuinely in scope.
-->
